states.label: B1 Field work below the schedule
states.description: The optional after slot renders the project's Field work card inside the fixed schedule page, below the schedule card and above the page footer. The card is at most 30% of the viewport high and scrolls on its own; the schedule card keeps at least 240 px while it is present. Without the slot the Gantt renders exactly as before.

gaps.actual: Implementation captures only; no exact mockup or HTML for the card

states.label: B1 shared Button inside the schedule page
states.description: Link a work order, Unlink, Cancel, Link work order and Unlink work order use the shared Button. Inside #ppo-gantt-page the Gantt's button reset is overridden for the Field work card so primary, secondary and danger variants, the 44 px minimum height and the shared font return.
